CAMEL-25413: camel-kubernetes: fix trustCerts annotation from security=secret to insecure:ssl

The trustCerts option turns off TLS certificate validation, so it is an
insecure TLS flag, not a secret. The bulk migration in CAMEL-23250
annotated it as security=secret, so the security policy framework
(camel.main.profile=prod) could not warn or fail fast when certificate
validation was disabled.

KubernetesConfiguration.trustCerts is now annotated with
security=insecure:ssl and insecureValue=true, the catalog metadata, the
endpoint URI factories and SecurityUtils are regenerated for the 20
kubernetes and openshift components, and the 4.23 upgrade guide documents
that trustCerts=true is now flagged by the security policy, with the
camel.security.allowedProperties escape hatch. This follows the same
pattern as CAMEL-24999 (camel-hivemq) and CAMEL-25414 (camel-mongodb).

Closes #27503

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Andrea Cosentino <ancosen@gmail.com>

CAMEL-25495: camel-jbang: pick the Quarkus Dockerfile by --java-version

camel export --runtime=quarkus wrote src/main/docker/Dockerfile and
Dockerfile.jvm with a fixed ubi9/openjdk-21-runtime base image, whatever
--java-version said. A project exported with --java-version=25 was
compiled for Java 25 but started on a Java 21 runtime, so the container
failed with UnsupportedClassVersionError.

The Quarkus fast-jar Dockerfile is now picked by Java version from the
FreeMarker templates Dockerfile-quarkus21.ftl and Dockerfile-quarkus25.ftl,
as Camel Main and Spring Boot already do. That selection moves into
Export.processDockerfileTemplate. It falls back to the Java 21 template
only when no template exists for the requested version
(TemplateNotFoundException). Any other template error is now raised
instead of silently producing the Java 21 image. Camel Main and Spring
Boot export the same Dockerfiles as before.

Closes #27617

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

CAMEL-25481: camel-dataweave - convert XML namespaces, attributes and the DataSonnet XML model (#27612)

* CAMEL-25481: camel-dataweave - convert XML namespaces, attributes and the DataSonnet XML model

The DataWeave to DataSonnet conversion now follows the DataWeave XML semantics.

XML input: a selector matches an element by its local name whatever its namespace
prefix (such as payload.Envelope.Body of a SOAP message), .ns#name only in the namespace
of an ns header directive, .@ gives all the attributes and ..* all the descendants, an
empty element is null, and the object functions see the child elements in document
order. An output other than XML writes the elements without the attributes, namespace
declarations and positions of the DataSonnet XML model (dw.output).

XML output: attributes (key @(name: value)), namespace-qualified keys (ns0#key),
null as an empty element, arrays, object spreads and keys that repeat as elements that
repeat (in the order of the script), elements of the input with their attributes and
namespaces, and the writeDeclaration and skipNullOn writer properties.

DataSonnet does not keep the value of a function argument (each use evaluates it
again), so nested calls of the camel-dataweave.libsonnet functions took exponential time
in the depth of the nesting. The functions now evaluate their arguments once.

The corpus has 29 new XML entries, verified with the DataWeave CLI, and compares XML
outputs without formatting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claus Ibsen <claus.ibsen@gmail.com>

* CAMEL-25481: parenthesize mixed && / || conditions, rewrap the upgrade guide note

Review feedback.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claus Ibsen <claus.ibsen@gmail.com>

* CAMEL-25481: camel-dataweave - fix CDATA next to text, namespaces with the same local name, empty arrays and nested lambdas

Review fixes:

- The text of an element with text and CDATA segments was read twice (the reader also
  gives it in '$'); adjacent text and CDATA in mixed content are one __text.
- .*name and ..*name give the elements of every namespace with that local name, in
  document order (and .name the first in document order).
- An empty array is an empty element also in an object with a spread or a repeated key.
- A lambda parameter kept as an XML element for its attributes is tracked in its scope,
  so an inner lambda with a parameter of the same name does not change it.

Five corpus entries for these, verified with the DataWeave CLI.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Claus Ibsen <claus.ibsen@gmail.com>

CAMEL-25491: Fix semantic evaluation lifecycle and diagnostics

Serialize CLI semantic executor initialization, submission and shutdown,
and reject late requests once stopping begins. Stop transport polling before
acquiring the executor monitor so file dispatch can finish safely.

Preserve error details for message-less exceptions on both console failure
paths, and reject calls after console shutdown until it is restarted.
Throttle missing semantic-console discovery to five-second retries while
preserving late registration. Restore server-side action failure warnings.

Add regressions for executor initialization racing with shutdown, late
calls, failure details, and discovery retry behavior.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

CAMEL-25191: Fix flaky test MainNotAutoConfiguredWarningTest (#27603)

The test installs a custom WARN appender on the BaseMainSupport Log4j logger in
@BeforeEach/@AfterEach, mutating global LoggerContext state. Under JUnit parallel
execution, AiObservabilityConfigurationPropertiesTest concurrently emits WARN logs for
unconsumed camel.aiObservability.enable properties, which leak into the test appender
and cause assertion failures (17% rate normally, 78% with -T1C).

The test is now @Isolated, as the other tests in the module that mutate global JVM
state, and drops the public modifiers per JUnit 5 conventions.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet <noreply@anthropic.com>
